content: Ishaan Bose followed up regarding his healthy policy with DCoders (Policy No: HP-001234) appearing as expired in the system. He confirmed no changes to premiums or coverage and requested an urgent review. Insurance agent Karan Joshi apologized for the auto-renewal issue, stated he has escalated the matter to the technical team for resolution, and assured Ishaan that the policy will be reinstated without any gap in coverage.

action_items: Technical team to resolve the auto-renewal issue
Karan Joshi to keep Ishaan Bose updated on the status
